messages:
arya: Preflight results for new rdx-7b-int8 (seed v1). Short summary: quantization reduced GPU memory ~3.8x, throughput up for batchy workloads, but p95 latency +120ms and quality shows a regression on our summarization eval. Details below.

mike: Which baseline did you compare against? and how big was the AB sample?

arya: Baseline = rdx-7b-1.2fp16. A/B run: 24h, ~120k sampled requests across production routes. Key deltas: 
```
metric,baseline,quant_v1,delta
ROUGE-L,0.623,0.611,-0.012 (-1.9%)
Human-helpfulness,0.712,0.704,-0.008 (-1.1%)
Hallucination-rate,0.042,0.048,+0.006 (+0.6pp)
p50_latency_ms,78,81,+3
p95_latency_ms,210,330,+120
```
(Those are aggregated; per-route breakdown in the report link.)

elaine: ROUGE-L down 1.9% is above our soft guard of 1.5%. Human delta -1.1% is concerning. Is this concentrated on any prompt slice?

arya: Yes — regressions concentrated on long-instruction and multi-step planning prompts. Short Q/A and chat routes are mostly unaffected. We suspect quant-induced attention approximation on long seqs.

sanjay: Operationally we need an automatic fallback policy. My proposal: auto-fallback if ANY of: ROUGE-L delta <= -1.5% (absolute), hallucination_delta >= +0.5pp, or p95_latency increase >= +200ms vs baseline. Also require targeted long-instruction eval pass before promotion beyond 5%.

rollout-checker: smoke-check: unit tests ok, perf-smoke ok, but eval-regression flag set (ROUGE-L). See /checks/1769201234.

mike: Sounds reasonable. Suggest rollout phases [1,5,20,100] with 24h hold per phase and automatic rollback if any of sanjay's conditions trip. Also add a manual hold point after 5% to run targeted 2k long-instruction eval. Approve?

elaine: Approve with that manual hold. Also add a cost monitor — quant changed token-cost distribution for some routes. If token-cost/spike > 10% alert.

arya: Good catches. I'll update rollout config and open PR. Thinking initial phase 1% for 24h, then 5% with manual hold (elaine run long-instruction eval), then 20% if green.

arya: Rollout config snippet I will push: 
```
rollout:
  phases: [1,5,20,100]
  hold_hours: 24
  manual_hold_after: 5
  auto_fallback_if:
    rouge_l_delta_lte: -0.015
    hallucination_delta_gte: 0.005
    p95_latency_increase_ms_gte: 200
    token_cost_spike_pct_gte: 10
  targeted_eval_after: 5
```

sanjay: Please add metric hooks for per-route p95 and targeted-eval, and ensure fallback is immediate (no human gate) if p95 latency > baseline +200ms — that kills user experience.

mike: Action items: arya -> PR with updated rollout + CI checks, elaine -> run targeted long-instruction eval and sanity human eval, sanjay -> add metric hooks and alert rules.

arya: Created PR #4231 (link in thread). I'll kick off 1% tomorrow 10:00 UTC and watch the hooks. Will DM if we see any noisy signals. :thumbsup:
